title: I built a 2D retro style traffic racer game using antigravity
author: rakeshozon
selftext:
Been working on this solo for a while — a simple 2D top-down traffic racer, retro style, no ads, no data collection, just dodge traffic and see how far you can go.

GenAI disclosure: I used Antigravity (AI coding assistant) heavily throughout development — including mechanics like coin collection and other gameplay systems. Wanted to be upfront about that per sub rules.

Would genuinely love feedback if anyone tries it — bugs, difficulty balance, anything that feels off. Still actively improving it.

Play Store link :- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.racer2d.trafficracer
